messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: Elevated 5xx rate for model variant custom-erb-2025 in us-east-1. 15m avg = 7.8% (baseline 0.3%). Policy: error-rate-policy.high

alice (oncall): ack — paging the SRE rotation. marking P1 until we triage. who’s seeing customer impact?

ben (runtime): confirmed in traces. P95 latency jumped 120ms -> 950ms for that variant. KV-cache miss rate spiked at same time.

carlos (sre): I’m seeing repeated OOMs on a subset of pods serving the quantized binary. host logs show: "kv_cache_lookup: corrupted fragment" on 3 hosts. CPU fine, memory pressure on GPUs.

DANA (prodops): tagging P1. we should consider immediate traffic containment for that variant — customers are hitting 502/timeouts.

eve (support): two enterprise tickets from acme and betaapps reporting timeouts and failed requests. betaapps uses this variant as default via feature flag and is high-volume.

alice (oncall): mitigation proposal: 1) apply emergency rate-limit to noisy API keys 2) set custom-erb-2025 weight -> 0% and shift to omni-v4-stable 3) cordon affected hosts 4) open follow-up incident ticket. objections?

frank (customer-success): +1 to removing variant. customers prefer predictable behavior even if slightly different outputs. we’ll prep comms.

ben (runtime): agree. command to run: 
```
redwoodctl route update --variant custom-erb-2025 --weight 0 --reason "emergency-disable-5xx-spike"
redwoodctl route update --variant omni-v4-stable --weight +100
```
I’ll also reduce concurrency on the draining hosts to avoid extra OOM cycles.

alice (oncall): creating emergency quota slice for heavy keys now: `quotactl slice add --policy emergency-heavy-keys --limit 50rps` and applying to top noisy keys.

deploy-bot: route update job queued: job_id=job-3111112222-01. applying in 10s.

deploy-bot: route update job job-3111112222-01 succeeded. New routing: custom-erb-2025=0%, omni-v4-stable=100%.

ben (runtime): routing changes observed. traffic draining off custom-erb-2025. omni-v4-stable absorbing load; error-rate for the cluster dropping.

carlos (sre): cordoned the 3 hosts with KV corruption and rotated traffic off them. taking binary snapshots and KV cache dumps for forensic. no sign of unauthorized access in audit logs.

eve (support): notified acme and betaapps via email + status page update. acme acknowledged: "Thanks — appreciate quick action."

alice (oncall): metrics check in 5m. @ben please post 10m rolling error-rate and latency after reroute.

ben (runtime): 5m after reroute: cluster 5xx = 0.15%, draining variant residual <0.1%. omni-v4-stable 5xx ~0.25% (slightly elevated), P95 latency ~140ms. KV-cache errors no longer increasing.

alice (oncall): marking immediate mitigation successful. initiating handoff to SRE for root cause and recovery plan. carlos will lead RCA.

carlos (sre): next actions: collect heapdumps, KV cache state, run integrity checks on quantized model artifacts, and validate last-night canary rollout for custom-erb-2025. suspect: rare KV corruption under high concurrency with quantized kernels.

DANA (prodops): filing INCIDENT-3111 with action items: rollback quant changes on custom-erb-2025, revert canary, update autoscaler thresholds, and add a runbook entry for corrupted-kv scenarios.

frank (customer-success): scheduling follow-up syncs with affected customers. request ETA from eng on when it’s safe to re-enable or a safe alternative variant to recommend.

alice (oncall): summary note: mitigation = reroute to omni-v4-stable + emergency quotas + cordon effected hosts. leaving thread open for postmortem updates. thanks all :thumbsup:

incident-bot: INCIDENT-3111112222 status: mitigated -> monitoring. Pager cleared. Mitigation actions logged: route weight 0, emergency quota applied, hosts cordoned. Follow-up ticket: INCIDENT-3111.

ben (runtime): short postmortem snippet to attach: pattern observed — KV cache corruption triggered under high concurrency when serving quantized binary, causing repeated OOMs on GPUs and a cascade of 5xx responses. attaching traces/logs to INCIDENT-3111.
